title: wss: unknown client @type ignore contradicts 8887
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00.md:299, draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-wss-00.md:393, draft-atwood-jmap-scene-wss-00.md:926 say servers SHOULD silently ignore unknown client @type. RFC 8887 4.3.1: server MUST return a Problem Details object for request-level errors (invalid JMAP object). Fix: respond with RequestError notRequest, keep connection open.
close_reason: Unknown client @type now cites RFC 8887 4.3.1's existing MUST (RequestError, notRequest type) in all three; no new MUST added.
